kia: FYI onboarding sampleapp: under a short burst the Python SDK sometimes returns duplicate list items. Node+Go can't repro.
kia: Quick repro: run sampleapp --concurrency=40 --prefetch=2 against staging token; after a few auth refreshes duplicates appear.
nate: Do we have inflight counting in two places? paginator + request runner?
kia: In python it's in client/prefetch/semaphore.py. Traced to retry handler: when AuthError triggers a retry path we re-enqueue without releasing the permit.
mohit: That would cause inflight to drift up. Can you paste the minimal log excerpt?
kia: Sure:
```
DEBUG paginator fetched p=4 inflight=5
WARN auth refresh failed, scheduling retry
DEBUG paginator fetched p=4 inflight=6
DEBUG paginator fetched p=4 inflight=6  # duplicate fetch observed
```
nate: Simple fix: ensure acquire/release are in a finally or use a contextmanager around the whole fetch+retry lifecycle. Node uses a contextmanager so it doesn't leak.
kia: I validated locally by wrapping with with inflight.permit(): and it stopped reproducing.
mohit: Can you open a PR with a unit test that simulates concurrent auth failures + an integration run on staging? Add an instrumentation counter inflight_permit_leak_total too.
ci-bot: CI history: https://ci.redwood/flake/4912 shows flaky.test_paginator_double_fetch on linux-py.
kia: Will add README troubleshooting note for onboarding customers and backport to 0.8.2/0.8.3 patches. Opening PR in ~20m.
nate: Nice work, thanks. :thumbsup:
